name: Allostatic Prediction
description: Predictive regulation of metabolic resources to meet anticipated demands. Extension of homeostasis (fixed setpoint) to flexible allostasis (predictive setpoint adjustment). Brain predicts future needs and adjusts autonomic state proactively.
key_references: Sterling, P. (2012). Allostasis: A model of predictive regulation. Physiology & Behavior, 106(1), 5-15.
Barrett, L. F., & Simmons, W. K. (2015). Interoceptive predictions in the brain. Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 16(7), 419-429.
empirical_evidence: Conceptual appeal: explains why autonomic changes precede physical demands. Heart rate increases before exertion. Blood glucose adjusts in anticipation of eating (cephalic phase). fMRI evidence emerging. Debate: is this true prediction or conditioned response? Mechanistic evidence limited.
